manual_checks.evidence: Code: canManage = can(principal, 'prospects:manage') is computed server-side in prospectSalesView. Only the owner role holds prospects:manage (core/auth/capabilities.ts). Controls render only when canManage && summary && !serverLock (held or archived). AssignmentMenu sends {mode, expectedAssignee, to?, openFollowUp?}, matching the strict parser in lib/sales-http.ts. Save stays disabled until an open-follow-up choice is made, and transfer is not offered on unassign (the server also refuses it). FollowUpEditor PATCHes {expected, changes} with only the changed fields, restates dueAt whenever the date changes (as executeFollowUpEdit requires for timed follow-ups), and resolves Pacific DST gaps and ambiguities before sending. ReopenProspect is shown only on closed-lost and sends {expectedStage: 'closed-lost', stage: {to}}; the server keeps reopen owner-only. Every refusal forgets the command id (useSalesCommand), so a re-confirm after assignment_conflict, followup_conflict or followup_choice_required is a new command, while Retry after an uncertain outcome reuses the same id and body with inputs locked. Rendered end-to-end through the real routes on a throwaway PG 17.6 fixture at 1440x900: the owner transferred o-8 to Priya with 'Transfer', and the page refreshed showing the new assignee and follow-up; the follow-up edit Call to Email saved and displayed; reopening closed-lost to Contacted saved, and the Reopen control disappeared.

At all six viewports, the Sales member saw none of Reassign / unassign, Edit follow-up or Reopen prospect on the open prospect (o-1) or the closed-lost one (o-2). Held (o-5) and archived (o-6) prospects showed no owner controls to the owner either. The server independently refused the Sales principal: POST assignment 403 forbidden, reopen via actions 403 reopen_not_permitted, follow-up PATCH 403 forbidden. The routes still declare prospects:manage (assignment, follow-up PATCH) and prospects:write plus the role check for reopen. No route, capability or refusal code changed in this diff.

There was 0px document horizontal overflow on the default and long-name pages and inside every dialog, and no visible target under 44px in any state. Inputs are 16px. The dialog is a bottom sheet on phones, centred at 640 to 768, and a side sheet at 1024 and above; at 667x375 the body scrolls with the footer buttons in view. A 130-character business name wraps, and the controls reflow without clipping. Keyboard (1440 and 390): each trigger is reachable by Tab with a visible 2px :focus-visible outline, Enter opens the dialog with focus on its Close button, Tab stays in the dialog (the only non-dialog stop is BODY, Chrome's native modal wrap, and outside links are inert), Escape closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.
